# Bid the alcove, the unit, and the extras.

> Bid a walk-in tub the way the trade does — alcove, unit, extras, who bought the tub, and whether Saturday still pays — not a published installed dump — and see the margin before you send the price.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
